# Sync ZipCode validation with Country selection and field references

## Context

Surfaced while reviewing `#21515` (`#21339`, `MESSAGE:390eb4eb-b531-4c6c-9dff-fafc4e905142`), where `AC-2` asks postal-code fields to follow the selected `Neo.form.field.Country`: pairing `Neo.form.field.ZipCode` and `Neo.form.field.Country` via `countryField` or `zipCodeField` fails across event payload shape, record key property, ISO case normalization, listener cleanup, and string-reference resolution.

## The Problem

Measured in `src/form/field/ZipCode.mjs`, `src/form/field/Country.mjs`, and `src/util/CountryFlags.mjs`:

1. **`onCountryFieldChange` reads `data.record` (`undefined`) instead of `ComboBox`'s `Record` on `data.value`:**
   - `ComboBox#fireChangeEvent` (`src/form/field/ComboBox.mjs:614-616`) emits `{component: me, oldValue, value}` where `data.value` is the selected `Record` (and `Country#value` holds that `Record`, whereas `value.record` at `ZipCode.mjs:86` is `undefined`). `ZipCode#onCountryFieldChange` (`ZipCode.mjs:113`) reads `data.record?.[this.countryKeyProperty] || null`, so `countryCode` always resolves to `null`.
2. **Key-property and case mismatch between `CountryFlags.countries` (`code: 'de'`) and `ZipCode` (`countryKeyProperty: 'id'`, `countryCodes.DE`):**
   - `Country`'s built-in store (`src/form/field/Country.mjs:34-42`) defines `{fields: ['name', 'code'], keyProperty: 'code'}` over `CountryFlags.countries` (`{code: 'de', name: 'germany'}` in lowercase), whereas `ZipCode` defaults `countryKeyProperty` to `'id'` (`ZipCode.mjs:47`) and indexes `ZipCode.countryCodes` by uppercase `'AT'`, `'CH'`, `'DE'` (`ZipCode.mjs:15-19`) with no `beforeSetCountryCode` normalization.
3. **Listener leak and stale `countryCode` on `countryField` replacement/unmount:**
   - `ZipCode#afterSetCountryField(value, oldValue)` (`ZipCode.mjs:75-90`) never detaches `oldValue?.un('change', me.onCountryFieldChange, me)` (nor on `destroy()`), and `value.value && me.onCountryFieldChange(...)` skips syncing `countryCode = null` when reassigned to an empty `countryField`.
4. **Broken string-reference contracts on `ZipCode#countryField_` and `Country#zipCodeField_`:**
   - Both configs document `"You can either pass a field instance or a field reference"` (`ZipCode.mjs:38-42`, `Country.mjs:53-57`), yet `ZipCode#beforeSetCountryField` calls `me.up().getReference(value)` (`ZipCode.mjs:103`) — throwing `TypeError` when `me.up()` is `null`, missing references in ancestor containers (e.g. sibling `hbox` rows), and returning `null` when `ZipCode` precedes `Country` in `items` — while `Country` implements no `beforeSetZipCodeField` at all (`Country` preceding `ZipCode` in `items` is the standard address-form order).

## The Architectural Reality

- `Design authority: "You can either pass a field instance or a field reference @member {Neo.form.field.Base|String|null} countryField_=null" / "@member {Neo.form.field.Base|String|null} zipCodeField_=null"` (`src/form/field/ZipCode.mjs:38-46`, `src/form/field/Country.mjs:53-57`, `src/form/field/ComboBox.mjs:611-616`).
- `Neo.form.field.Base` (`src/form/field/Base.mjs`) is the shared base class of both `ZipCode` and `Country` and already imports `ComponentManager` and hooks `afterSetParentId(value, oldValue)`. Meanwhile `Neo.container.Base#createItems` (`src/container/Base.mjs:540`) emits `itemsCreated` synchronously once all child `items` are constructed and registered in `ComponentManager`.
- Placing a small protected `resolveFieldReference(value, configName)` helper on `Neo.form.field.Base` eliminates code duplication between `ZipCode` and `Country` while resolving string references across ancestor containers immediately when already constructed, on ancestor `itemsCreated` when declared earlier in `items` (including nested rows), and on `afterSetParentId` when added dynamically.

## The Fix

1. **`src/form/field/Base.mjs`:**
   - Add protected `resolveFieldReference(value, configName)` (plus `#pendingFieldReferences` / `#pendingReferenceParents` cleanup in `afterSetParentId` and `destroy`) so any field config accepting an instance-or-reference string resolves across `ComponentManager.getParents(this)` immediately or as soon as enclosing container `itemsCreated` / `afterSetParentId` fires.
2. **`src/form/field/ZipCode.mjs`:**
   - Default `countryKeyProperty` to `'code'` (falling back to string `record.id` when `countryKeyProperty === 'code'` and `record.code == null` so custom `id`-keyed ComboBoxes continue to work).
   - Add `beforeSetCountryCode(value)` normalizing string codes via `value.trim().toUpperCase() || null`.
   - Delegate `beforeSetCountryField(value)` to `this.resolveFieldReference(value, 'countryField')`.
   - In `afterSetCountryField(value, oldValue)` and `destroy(...args)`, detach `oldValue` / active `countryField` `'change'` listeners cleanly and sync `onCountryFieldChange` even when `value.value` is `null`.
   - In `onCountryFieldChange(data)`, resolve the country code from `data?.record ?? data?.value` across `Record` / plain objects, `store`-backed string values, storeless `Text` strings, and `null`.
3. **`src/form/field/Country.mjs`:**
   - Add `beforeSetZipCodeField(value)` delegating to `this.resolveFieldReference(value, 'zipCodeField')`, detach `oldValue.countryField` in `afterSetZipCodeField` / `destroy` when owned by `this`, and add `@summary` JSDoc.
4. **`test/playwright/unit/form/field/ZipCodeValidate.spec.mjs`:**
   - Add unit suites covering `Country` ↔ `ZipCode` instance linking, lowercase `'de'`/`'at'`/`'ch'` normalization + live re-validation on country change/clear, string-reference linking in both sibling orders (`countryField: 'country'` and `zipCodeField: 'zip'`, nested rows, and `container.add`), custom `id`-keyed `ComboBox` fallback, and listener cleanup on replacement/destroy.

## Decision Record impact

none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1 (`Country` ↔ `ZipCode` value & `change` sync):** Linking a `Neo.form.field.Country` (holding lowercase ISO codes such as `'de'`, `'at'`, `'ch'`, `'us'` in `CountryFlags.countries`) to `Neo.form.field.ZipCode` via either `zip.countryField` or `country.zipCodeField` normalizes `zip.countryCode` to uppercase (`'DE'`, `'AT'`, `'CH'`, `'US'`), updates `zip.inputPattern`, and re-validates dirty `ZipCode` values when the country changes or clears to `null`.
- [ ] **AC-2 (Bidirectional string `reference` resolution across construction orders):** Passing a string `reference` to `ZipCode#countryField` or `Country#zipCodeField` resolves the target field regardless of sibling order in `Container#items`, across nested row containers, and when added dynamically via `container.add()`, without throwing when `up()` is initially `null`.
- [ ] **AC-3 (Custom `ComboBox` compatibility & listener hygiene):** `ZipCode` still resolves string `id` codes from custom `ComboBox` stores (as well as custom `countryKeyProperty` overrides) and detaches `'change'` / pending `itemsCreated` listeners when `countryField` / `zipCodeField` is replaced, cleared, or destroyed.

## Out of Scope

- Adding new country regexes beyond `AT`, `CH`, `DE` to `ZipCode.countryCodes`.
- Modifying `apps/form/view/pages/AddressPage.mjs` or `#21339`'s contributor checkout form PR (`#21515`).

## Avoided Traps

- **Duplicating deferred reference-listener plumbing in both `ZipCode.mjs` and `Country.mjs`:** Both extend `Neo.form.field.Base`, which already owns `ComponentManager` parent traversal and `afterSetParentId`; centralizing `resolveFieldReference` on `Base` avoids copy-paste drift.
- **Mutating `CountryFlags.countries` to uppercase `'DE'`:** `CountryFlags.getFlagUrl` and existing app tests (`FormApp.spec.mjs:86`, `value: 'de'`) rely on lowercase codes in `Country`'s store; normalizing in `ZipCode#beforeSetCountryCode` preserves full backwards compatibility.
